mapper.select: select mi.id, mi.project_no, mi.name, mi.status, mi.approve_user_name, mi.approve_time, md.id as detailId, md.mould_no, md.third_mould_no, md.type_id, md.mould_holes, md.length, md.width, md.height, md.material, md.life_cycle, md.develop_cycle, md.enable_date, md.supplier_id, md.remark, md.create_user_name, md.update_user_name, md.update_time from mould_info mi left join mould_detail md on mi.id = md.main_id and md.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and mi.is_deleted = false

select mi.id, mi.project_no, mi.name, mi.status, md.id as detailId, md.mould_no, md.third_mould_no, md.supplier_id, md.update_time, mra.is_need_refund, mra.refund_standard, mra.refund_order_qty, mra.refund_amount, mra.refund_status from mould_info mi inner join mould_detail md on mi.id = md.main_id and md.is_deleted = false left join mould_refund_agreement mra on md.id = mra.mould_detail_id and mra.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and mi.is_deleted = false

select mrcqd.purchase_qty, mrcqd.receive_qty, mrcqd.stock_in_qty, mrcqd.purchase_order_code, mrcqd.po_create_time, mrcqd.sku_id, mrcqd.sku_no, mrcqd.supplier_id from mould_ref_calc_qty AS mrcq inner join mould_ref_calc_qty_detail AS mrcqd on mrcq.id = mrcqd.main_id and mrcqd.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and mrcq.is_deleted = false and mrcq.mould_detail_id = #{params.mouldDetailId}
